bio: On the road to the mountain resorts of the Aravis range, between La Clusaz and Le Grand Bornand, this small mountain chalet needs to be marked with a pile of stones, like a cairn! In the small, inviting space done out in mountain style, there is no doubt about it: chef Adrien and maître d' Charline (all smiles) know how to delight their faithful guests. Adrien creates astonishing dishes that are full of flavour and beautifully fresh: the cold lettuce soup with cream of country bacon is a tasty sensation; tender medallions of farm-reared lamb served rare......
